title: Get a permit to sell goods or run a stall in a public place
what: Get the council's permit before selling goods, or running a business from a stall, in a street, mall or other public place.

laws.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010

sources.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010
sources.locator: by-law 13(1) (version as in force at 5 August 2010)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not, without a permit, sell goods in a public place.

sources.title: Alice Springs (Management of Public Place) By-laws 2010
sources.locator: by-law 19(1) (version as in force at 5 August 2010)
sources.quote: (1) A person must not, without a permit, conduct business from a stall in a public place.
